description: The board grid at all four widths. It sits far below the fold, so the capture hovers a selector inside the band to bring it into frame - a URL fragment does not scroll a capture, which is why the older /#board scenario shoots the hero instead. Portraits in a grid are the homepage's densest layout, so this is where a column count that works at 1440 and fails at 768 shows up.
